reservoir._comment_seal_study: 2026-11-19 SEAL-AND-DEAD-VOLUME.md: plunger core is now 4.76 long with the front flange 0.46 behind the front bead, dead layer 0.04 (dead + plunger_len = 4.80 as before, so the CNC reservoir length is unchanged); core clearance 0.1 per side; the separate printed nose is gone (nose_len 0).

drive._comment: Faulhaber ADM0620-2R-V3 (Ø6, 9.5 mm, 20 st/rev, 0.2 mNm) + 06/1 planetary 16:1 (nominal; 2 stages). gearhead_len DERIVED (9.2+2.7/stage), VERIFY on datasheet. Screw M1.6x0.35 stainless rod, DIN 934 M1.6 nut.
drive._note: Zhaowei ZWBPD006006 6mm planetary-gear stepper, 1 stage (listed 5/6:1; 5.0 assumed). Gearbox 9.7 mm, total 23.7 mm (vendor page). 20 steps/rev ASSUMED (TODO-VERIFY with seller).

cannula._comment: ALL TODO-MEASURE (no public data; guessed from photos). Insight Flex cannula head = round transparent dome with a side septum; the tubing-side connector slides on sideways. See cannula-measurement.md. Measurement letters A..P.

seal._comment: Cast silicone bead seal, three mould variants (op_seal.py, op_mould.py, SEAL-AND-DEAD-VOLUME.md). free_oversize = cavity tip diameter minus 16.0 (before cast shrink ~0.1-0.2 %).

S1.role: fall-back: more squeeze (~0.047 mm per side), single front bead, land 0.20; use if S2 leaks

S2.role: ACTIVE (CAD) / lowest friction: land 0.15, net squeeze ~0.03 mm per side; leak margin thinner

T.role: twin bead (redundant seal, longer guide), about 1.7x the friction of S1 (use if S1 leaks)

guide._note: [ASM] mu_g = core flange vs PP bore, silicone-oil wetted. tape_recess: both core flanges are turned down by this much per side so that one wrap of 0.1 mm PTFE thread-seal tape (optional) restores the 0.1 mm clearance and lowers the guide friction to ~0.10 (see SEAL-AND-DEAD-VOLUME.md, cocking).

_notes: Rev A orderable. See parts.md / README.md.

zw_pd6_1stage._note: BACKUP motor (Zhaowei ZWBPD006006 / '6.43' 6 mm planetary stepper). Zhaowei ZWBPD006006 6mm planetary-gear stepper, 1 stage (listed 5/6:1; 5.0 assumed). Gearbox 9.7 mm, total 23.7 mm (vendor page). 20 steps/rev ASSUMED (TODO-VERIFY with seller).

faulhaber_adm0620_16._note: Premium: ADM0620-2R-V3 (9.5 mm, 20 st/rev, datasheet) + 06/1 16:1 (length derived 11.9, VERIFY).

nfp_608_26._note: NFP-608-26.45-SGM (nfpshop.com, datasheet stepper-gear-motor-spec-NFP-608-26.45-SGM.pdf outline drawing): body d6.0+-0.1, length 15.1 = gearbox 8.1 + motor 8.0, front boss d3.5 x 0.8, rear boss d2.6 (short, 0.7 VERIFY), shaft d2.0 with D-flat 1.5 over 2.5 mm, 11.7 from the shaft reference line to the gearbox/motor junction (drawing not to scale), 4 terminal pins 1.2 pitch on the motor section pointing 'down' in the end view (order B, A-, B+, A), 20 steps/rev, ratio 26.45. Free shaft length is DERIVED from the drawing (VERIFY with calipers); shaft is cut to shaft_cut_x in the pod.

bench._comment: Bench pod (spec 4a). u = x - x_r1. All board features are relative to x_r1 -> one board for all sizes.
bench.revB_motor_contacts_note: Rev B spring-contact variant: order the NFP motor WITHOUT lead; pins B,A-,B+,A at 1.2 mm pitch, see layout.json motor_pins_revB

gears._comment: GHW-Modellbau module 0.3 brass gears (gear-selection.md), modelled as TIP circles. DECISION 2026-11-19 (coordinator + sim): STEP-DOWN pair z16 (motor, GHW 390754, bore 2.0) : z20 (screw, GHW 753020 20 Z B, bore 2.0, hub trimmed). Screw turns z_motor/z_screw = 0.8 per motor turn: U/step = 0.00494 x 16/20 = 0.003951 (firmware preset needs ratio 26.45 x 20/16 = 33.06). Theoretical centre 0.15 x 36 = 5.40, built centre = theoretical + centre_add 0.11 = 5.51 (backlash window, sim 3.1). 15:12 (4.05) and 15:15 (4.50) cannot clear the carriage lane (needs >= 5.5 with the 4.8 mm carriage); 20:16 / 18:18 tips do not fit the 6.7 mm cavity without relief. z20 tip OD 6.6: 0.25 mm floor and lid relief pockets over the screw gear. x0 = gear plane start (rear corner limits the motor-gear tip circle to x >= 2.5, dry screw bosses at x 0.9..3.1 limit it to the screw-gear tip).

shim._comment: stainless steel tongue shim (laser cut, 0.5 x 1.4) glued into a carriage pocket; replaces the printed tongue (sim 4.4-4.6)

thrust._comment: axial stack of the leadscrew (bench side_gears): rear thrust sleeve (gear carrier, bears on the dry bush front face), front thrust collar (bears on the far bush end face), magnet glued to the rod end behind the collar: neither delivery nor draw thrust passes through the magnet. Sleeve/collar: brass tube or printed.

dock_interface_frozen._comment: FROZEN INTERFACE between the pod (bottom shell + end cap + pod sensor board) and the swappable DOCK INSERT (spec 8a). All insert variants fit this; the pod never changes for a new cannula fit. Pod frame: x relative to x_r1 (u), y relative to the dock axis y_c. Changing any number needs a decision entry in docs/STATUS.md.
dock_interface_frozen.needle_tip_x_u: dock.hub_x0 + dock.hub_t + dock.needle_free  (pod end cap, never changes)
dock_interface_frozen.mount: slide-in T-slot: the insert slides in along -X through the end-wall mouth until its front face meets the pod rear dock face at x0_u; the flange (z 0.5..0.88, |dy| up to pocket_half) runs on the ledge (z 0..0.45) so it cannot drop out towards the skin or move sideways; the d0.5 ledge bumps click into d0.9 holes in the flange (detent against the pull-off force); optional: a drop of cyanoacrylate. Tool-free swap: push the insert out with a pin from the open end.

dock._comment: pod side of the slide-on dock. y_c = dock axis in pod Y. arm_in = relaxed inner half spacing of the snap arms.

oring._note: catalogue O-ring 2.0 x 0.5 (NBR/silicone) in a face groove of the cap, sealing against the flat PP end face of the reservoir around the port: stretched 10 % on d2.2, cross-section 0.477, axial squeeze (0.477-0.40)/0.477 = 16 %. The d1.98 spigot only locates (clearance fit, NOT a seal).

cap._note_2026_11_19_review: septum bore = disc d x (1 - septum_compress) = 3.4 (radial compression 15 %), cavity 1.8 deep for a 2.0 disc (0.2 protrudes: the shell wall compresses it 0.1 axially, no air pocket behind it); needle hub bore = hub_d - hub_press (0.04 interference per side); main path channels d0.6 (L/D <= 5.3, flushable from both ends), fill branch d0.8 (drill/print straight legs).

sandwich._comment: clamped two-part sandwich (op_cap.py), spec 3c minimal fluid module. septum: disc (septum.d / len) or a bought septum (change d / len); needle: hub seat with UV-glued needle (dock.hub_d, cap.hub_press) or bare needle.

cap._note_3c: 2026-11-19 spec 3c: NO check valve, pressure fill. Minimal module: reservoir port -> septum chamber -> outlet needle. Septum on the UNDERSIDE (axis Z) at (x_r1 + septum_x, y_c - septum_dy), fill needle through cap.fill_hole_d and a hole in the pod floor; one gasket slot, no branches.

cover._comment: Hazard H14 (spec 3e): no check valve, so the fill septum must be physically unreachable while docked. Omnipod-style: the septum is on the pod UNDERSIDE inside the Velcro patch footprint (the floor recess `velcro`, extended forward to x_r1 + x_end_u), so the patch covers the underside, and therefore the fill-needle hole, whenever the pod sits on it (docked); the pod must be removed and turned over to fill. check.py: the hole footprint (septum x, y, hole d + needle radius) must lie inside the patch footprint; a plate directly under the floor blocks every ray (any angle) through the hole.

coax._comment: Coaxial NFP motor + sleeve coupler (see op_coax.py). All lengths VERIFY with the real motor. valve_d/valve_len/dock.valve_x0 are LEGACY (coaxial layout only): the bench pod has no check valve since spec 3c.

reservoir_frozen._comment: FROZEN INTERFACE of the CNC polypropylene reservoir (one order per size). Everything else (cap, septum, duckbill, needle, dock, housing) adapts to these numbers; do not change after the order.

reservoir_frozen.material: Polypropylene homopolymer (PP-H), natural, USP Class VI / medical grade if available
reservoir_frozen.datums: A = open dry-end face (x = 0); B = bottom flat (z = 0 at the lower outer flat); C = bore centre plane (y = 0)

All positions derive from the computed bench layout; only the numbers below are v0.1.0 choices.

reservoir_frozen_v010._comment: RE-FROZEN reservoir interface for v0.1.0 (decision 2026-11-19, spec 3d/2b; the old block `reservoir_frozen` is kept for history, bench pod). Wide closed stadium bore for the coaxial translating screw, CNC wall >= 1.0 mm (JLCCNC absolute minimum for plastics = DFM hard floor), end wall 2.0 (port d2.0 length 2.0), port OFFSET from the bore centre to the dock axis y_c. Open dry end x = 0, closed end x = length. Order once per size after the independent DFM review; changing a number needs a decision in docs/STATUS.md.
reservoir_frozen_v010.port_pos: closed end face, z = bore axis, y = bore centre MINUS port_dy (the dock axis)
reservoir_frozen_v010.material: Polypropylene homopolymer (PP-H), natural; water only in this project
reservoir_frozen_v010.datums: A = open dry-end face (x = 0); B = bottom flat (z = 0 at the lower outer flat); C = bore centre plane (y = 0)

pod._comment: v0.1.0 INTEGRATED POD (mechanical/op_pod.py): one coherent model, OP-100 and OP-200 only (spec 2c). Coaxial translating M1.6 screw (spec 3d) = the ONLY rod; the motor (NFP-608, or the Zhaowei d3.4 option) lies in the rear zone BESIDE the screw tail and meshes DIRECTLY with the nut gear (no idler, no side rod, no encoder lane: owner requirement 2026-11-19). Angle magnet = diametric RING on the nut-gear sleeve, TMAG5273 beside it on the SENSOR board. Boards: MAIN over the dock tunnel (+ wing over the cell), SENSOR board in the rear pocket, USB board + mid-mount waterproof USB-C in the rear wall, motor contact card, FPC spine under the reservoir. x from the rear outer face, y across (0..32), z from the skin (0).

nfp608.note: NFP-608-26.45-SGM (datasheet outline); stack = rear boss tail + motor + gearbox + front boss, from the rear boss tip

zw34.note: Zhaowei ZWBMD004004-36 (d3.4 x 13.3 mm, 3 V / 50 mA): ENVELOPE ONLY, torque/resistance/shaft unverified (docs/MOTOR-RESEARCH-2026-11-19.md); order samples before use

cup._comment: v0.1.0 'cup' pod (--drive cup, op_cup.py, V010-CUP.md): ONE M1.6 x 0.35 rod on the tank axis, rotating + axially fixed (bush behind the gear pair), driven by the NFP-608-26.45 through exactly TWO gears (module 0.3 z12 : z12 miter pair, 1:1, bought parts, see docs/BUY-LIST.md). The plunger is a long cup (stadium 15.8 x 4.8, seals at the closed front end, blind bore d2.0, brass nut in a hex pocket at the rear): the rod screws INTO it from behind and never touches the liquid. Tank = frozen CNC bore without slot. Dock tunnel BESIDE the tank, running the whole pod length, mouth in the rear (dry) end wall; end cap / needle at the front end. Battery, USB-C, boards = reserved keep-out boxes (ko_*). Coordinates: x = 0 at the OUTLET (front) end, +X toward the dry end; y = 0 at the -Y wall; z = 0 skin side.

gears.type: miter (bevel 1:1, 90 deg), brass, bought: AliExpress 1005010269458834 (2 gears per lot)
gears._geometry: distances are measured from the mating axis (apex of the pitch cones) along the gear axis. Gear A (motor, 2 mm bore, D-shaft press fit): drawing 0.96..4.22; FACED to front 1.2 (0.2 clearance to the d2 angle magnet, which has radius 1.0 > 0.96) and back 3.4 (keeps the motor, the lane-2 saddle and the E board screw where they are; remaining bore length 2.2 mm). Gear B (rod, 1 mm bore drilled 1.25 + tapped M1.6, screwed onto the rod): drawing 0.96..3.32, not faced. Envelope = 45 degree tip cone from the front to the pitch circle (r = a + m cos 45), back cone down to the hub radius, hub cylinder; teeth are not modelled (envelope overlaps of the pair are the meshing teeth, EXCLUDE pair).

vent.part: ePTFE vent membrane, adhesive-backed die-cut disc d2.0 (BUY-LIST Z14), bonded on the inner face of the -Y dock-pocket side wall over the d0.8 hole
vent._: challenge review #5: hidden vent from the dock pocket (outside) through the -Y pocket side wall into the empty space beside the pocket (old ko_side_a); without it a sealed pod reaches about -16 kPa at empty (+1.7 N on the plunger). Clean top kept

joint._comment: owner 2026-11-24 (2:1 print, visible gap): the shells close plastic-to-plastic on the rim (lid bottom face = rim top = z 5.0, outer seam flush); the seal sits in a GROOVE in the bottom-shell rim at constant distance from the outer wall, compressed by a TONGUE on the lid. The 0.9 mm wall allows only a 0.45 mm groove (0.225 mm walls): a buyable 0.8-1.0 mm cord needs >= 1.9 mm of rim, i.e. +2 mm width and length (the tank and the board edge sit 0-0.2 mm from the wall inner faces), so the seal is a cast silicone ring of the groove shape (STL OP-xxx_lid_gasket.stl). Offsets are from the outer outline (R4.8 corners).
joint._band: rim band z 4.45-5.0 thickens the bottom-shell wall to a constant 0.85 mm in the four corners (outer R4.8 vs inner R3.1 leaves only 0.57 on the diagonal), so the groove keeps a 0.175 inner wall there (0.85, not 0.9: the side_a / aux keep-outs reach to 0.03 of a 0.9 band)
joint.part: cast silicone ring 0.32 x 0.4 (Shore A 40-60, BUY-LIST Z4 cast silicone in a printed 2-part mould), open at the USB-C zone (x 23.5 +- 6.65, where the outer counterbore takes 0.6 of the wall): the joint there is covered on the wall inner face by the USB-C frame; dab of Z4 at the two ring ends

dock._comment: ALL values TODO-MEASURE (Insight Flex not measured). Head size re-estimated from the user photos by proportion (patch ~ 35 x 28 mm, head ~ 1/4 of the patch long side, 30G needle and tubing as scale): dome d8.0 x 4.2, base plate 9 x 9. Principle: pod lowered over the head into a bottom-open pocket (+0.2), slid `travel` mm toward the needle until the U-clip teeth drop into the dome side notches. Needle guard = spring-loaded sleeve (tip recessed when undocked).
dock._travel: challenge review #2: with the open +X end the 3.5 mm slide happens OUTSIDE the end face, so the pocket is clr + A + clr long (in_pod_reserve false); set it true to get the old 11.9 mm pocket back

hub.part: centring hub = 23G stainless tube (OD 0.64, ID 0.34) cut to 1.45 from a Z1 blunt needle (fallback 22G, OD 0.72 / ID 0.41), pressed into a d0.60 seat in the tank front wall; the 30G needle (OD 0.31) is bonded in it with CA (radial play 0.015)
hub._: challenge review #12: the old brass hub 1.5 x 0.2 (ID 1.1) left the 30G needle +-0.4 off axis

mouth_seal.part: flat frame plate cast in Z4 silicone (0.3 sheet between two plates) or cut, outline = pocket walls + roof (10.6 x 4.2), hole d1.8 for the needle guard
mouth_seal._: challenge review #5: closes the seam between the tank front face and the pocket mouth (walls + roof); replaces the hub gasket ring that sealed nothing; 17 % squeeze, the tank is pressed on it by the stop blocks (rear) and the pumping pressure

clip._t: challenge review #2: the pocket is 3.5 shorter, arm 7.55 -> 4.05 mm; 0.1 sheet would see 1220 MPa, 0.05 sheet 608 MPa (allow 650), 0.15 N per spring
clip.material: AISI 301 full hard (1.4310 C1300) 0.05 mm, laser-cut stencil part: two separate L-springs (arm + 90 deg anchor tab + bent-in tooth flap)
clip._anchor: owner 2026-11-24: the pocket is open at the +X end, so the U-clip bridge is gone; each arm ends in a 90 deg tab bent outward that is pushed from below into a 0.2 mm slot through an anchor block on the side wall at the open end (bonded with CA); the arm root stays where the bridge was (arm 4.05 mm with the 8.4 mm pocket)

fill._: z values relative to the tank underside (floor_tank); the fill channel runs 0.1 INTO the bore (challenge review #1: it stopped 0.1 short)

packing_voids._: challenge review #7: empty volumes that are NOT tank-convertible (the tank section is constant) and are accepted by cup_packing by name; any other empty 4 x 4 column fails
packing_voids.side_a: beside the dock pocket on the -Y side (old ko_side_a, empty; holds the vent membrane)
packing_voids.rear_a: rear corner of lane 1 beside gear B / TMAG, behind the tank dry rim (old ko_io, empty)
